prompt:
Hi, our quant team needs a sector rotation analysis for the semiconductor space. I've been told you can pull the right data automatically.

Please create a file called `semiconductor_analysis.json` that covers ALL stocks in the semiconductor (半导体) industry board. For each stock, include its full-year 2024 daily price performance metrics (specifically: annualized return as a decimal, and maximum drawdown as a negative decimal), its most recent quarterly reported revenue in 亿元 (labeled `latest_revenue`), and a composite rank from 1 (best) to N (worst) where rank is determined by: 60% weight on annualized return and 40% weight on the stock's revenue relative to the highest revenue in the group.

The JSON must also have a top-level `sector` field set to '半导体' and a `generated_date` field. Each stock entry needs: `code`, `name`, `annualized_return`, `max_drawdown`, `latest_revenue`, and `composite_rank`.

This is urgent for our Monday investment committee meeting.
